name: pr-watch
description: A macOS banner and a note in the session when the session's pull request is approved, turns ready to merge, leaves the merge queue, merges, closes, or deploys or fails to deploy, never a message in your name

stages.title: Deploy stages
stages.description: Branches a merged pull request moves through, in order, as branch=label pairs: main=dev, qa=qa, prod=prod. Empty, the default, skips the deploy events.

deployWorkflow.title: Deploy workflow
deployWorkflow.description: The workflow file whose push runs on each stage branch deploy it

bannerApp.title: Banner app
bannerApp.description: The session-banners helper app that shows the banners; a path that does not exist means notes only

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude
tellClaude.description: Also leave each event where Claude reads it with your next message, without starting a reply
